Question: In dream i saw gold bengles & earrings and as if i am so sad that i am not having all that things so what's the meaning of this? Answer ID: 5329 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 783/H/1429) Ma-sha-Allah, it is a nice dream.
